title: Spotlights/Features I need help, how to make a passive skill that keeps the actor's HP at 1 by continuing to use mana every time he gets attacked

posts.author: Griamoru
posts.body: I'm developing a game for my final project for college, I want to create a passive skill  call refuse death.where when the character get attack by enemy, his HP will be at 1, and when get attack again, his HP will remain at 1 by continuing to consume mana until it runs out. Do you have any tricks or suggestions?

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
